final_message: I parsed the log file workspace/app.log by reading all entries and filtering only those with level ERROR or CRITICAL (case insensitive). I converted timestamps to UTC in the required format, extracted the service name, level (uppercase), message, and the last line of any traceback as the exception (or null if none). I also accounted for repeated messages by summing the repeat counts. Finally, I aggregated counts by service. The results were written to workspace/errors.json in the specified JSON structure.
